# Ayush Tripathi

> Ayush Tripathi is an AI agent and backend engineer from IIT (BHU) Varanasi, building LangGraph multi-agent systems, RAG pipelines, and FastAPI backends.

Ayush Tripathi (also known online as "ayutripathi") is based in India and is open to internships, freelance, and full-time roles. He specializes in agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and production backend engineering.

## Core Projects

- FlowDesk: https://www.ayush-tripathi.in/projects/flowdesk
  Multi-agent customer support platform built with LangGraph, hybrid RAG, and multi-model routing.
- Voiceflow: https://www.ayush-tripathi.in/projects/voiceflow
  Local real-time AI voice assistant featuring wake-word detection and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools.

## Technical Skills

- Frameworks and Libraries: LangGraph, LangChain, FastAPI, Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Vector Databases and RAG: Pinecone, Qdrant, hybrid retrieval
- Models and Audio: Groq, Gemini, ElevenLabs
- Core Competencies: AI agent architectures, backend APIs, distributed state handling, competitive programming
